exactCanonicalSetting.sourceObservedSetting: features.bluetooth_filter: {"predicate":"RSSI = 0","interpretation":"best proxy for close social proximity"}

inputBoundary: One caller-parsed finite integer-valued RSSI value from an already-selected Bluetooth-hit record; the source explicitly describes RSSI as an 8-bit integer.
outputBoundary: Retain exactly RSSI-equals-zero records as the paper's close-social-proximity proxy; exclude both negative and positive values.
limitations: The source describes RSSI as an 8-bit relative indicator but does not disclose the study database field schema or serialization, so this binding does not parse raw records or infer a signed storage range.
This binding does not coerce missing, textual, or non-finite RSSI values.
This binding does not calibrate physical distance, group Bluetooth hits into scans, identify devices or contacts, deduplicate records, or construct downstream proximity summaries.
Exact numeric equality to zero is used; no tolerance or neighboring range is inferred.
